name: interior minimum and in-range evaluations
test:
def f(x):
    assert -10 <= x <= 10
    return (x-2)**2
x = minimize_convex(f, -10, 10, 1e-5)
assert -10 <= x <= 10
assert abs(x-2) <= 1e-5
print("ok")

name: endpoint minima
test:
x = minimize_convex(lambda x: x, -3, 7, 1e-5)
assert -3 <= x <= 7 and abs(x+3) <= 1e-5
x = minimize_convex(lambda x: -x, -3, 7, 1e-5)
assert -3 <= x <= 7 and abs(x-7) <= 1e-5
print("ok")

name: plateau and nonsmooth minimum
test:
x = minimize_convex(lambda x: max(0, abs(x)-2), -9, 8)
assert -2-1e-6 <= x <= 2+1e-6
assert abs(minimize_convex(lambda x: abs(x-0.25), -1, 1)-0.25) <= 1e-6
print("ok")

name: degenerate and already narrow interval
test:
def forbidden(x):
    raise AssertionError("unnecessary evaluation")
assert minimize_convex(forbidden, 3, 3) == 3
x = minimize_convex(lambda x: x*x, 0, 1e-8)
assert 0 <= x <= 1e-8
print("ok")

name: constant function
test:
def f(x):
    assert -4 <= x <= 6
    return 5.0
x = minimize_convex(f, -4, 6)
assert -4 <= x <= 6
print("ok")
